messages.subject: Calderwell CV-7 safety recall R-2025-118 - Brookmere fleet
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Gemma,

We are launching a voluntary safety recall on the CV-7 (ref R-2025-118) to apply a free braking-software update. Your fleet of 412 vehicles is our highest priority. Most are OTA-capable and we'll push the update over the air this week; for the remainder we'll arrange workshop slots to minimise downtime.

The customer notice is attached - please cascade the interim safety guidance (extra care braking on wet/slippery surfaces) to your drivers until the update is installed.

Kind regards,
Ian Forsythe
Field Quality, Calderwell Mobility

—
Calderwell Mobility Limited
Pioneer House, Trafford Park, Manchester M17 1WA
